lines.speaker: REX
lines.text: Radio Free Fierro, you're on the air. Tell me about the beeping.

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: It's in my clock radio, Rex. Seven little beeps and a long one. Every night. My dog won't go in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: REX
lines.text: Friends, that is not interference. That is a message. San Fierro has a ghost, and it's trying to talk.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Your radio's haunted, man.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Listen.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Seven short, one long, every ninety seconds, on one-six-six megahertz. People hear it all over the city.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So it's a ghost with a schedule.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Ghosts don't keep schedules. Transmitters do. A real ghost would have a favourite haunt. Let's find this one's.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We take bearings from two places. Where the lines cross, that's where it lives. Roughly.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Roughly?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Roughly is the honest version of exactly.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The receiver turns the signal into a needle and a sound. Watch the needle, but trust your ears.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Why my ears?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Because noise is loud and the pattern is quiet. Loud things like to pretend they're important.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Sounds like half the people I know.

lines.speaker: REX
lines.text: Callers say the beeping is loudest near Queens. Coincidence? I don't believe in coincidences. I believe in Queens.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Park on the marker and hold still. The antenna does the rest.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Bearing one. Strong, too.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Bearing two. The lines cross in Queens. Near a nightclub.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Hold still. You're smearing the bearing.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The needle's pinned here. But listen to it.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: That's just buzzing.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That sign has a dying transformer. It sprays noise into every channel, ours included.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: R.A.I.N. wants a verdict. Is this our ghost?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Rejected. Loud isn't the same as the source. The pattern's still out there, under the buzz.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accept? Carl, it's buzzing. Our ghost beeps. Listen again.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We can do better than abstain. The pattern isn't in this noise at all. That's a reject.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So we followed the loudest thing in the city.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Everybody does. That's why it's a trap. New plan: on foot, with the handheld, away from the sign.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Take the handheld. Turn slowly. When the beeps get clean and loud, hold it there.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's a bearing. Back in the van.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Wait. This one points straight up at the bridge.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So the ghost lives on the Gant Bridge. Rex was right?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Or the bridge is a mirror. The cables bounce the signal. We might be hearing an echo.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Same question for R.A.I.N. Is the source on the bridge?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Rejected. The bearing swings when we move. A real source holds still. An echo doesn't.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: If it was up there, the bearing wouldn't move when we did. It moved. Try again.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We have the swing on record. That's evidence. It's an echo, so we can reject this.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: One more bearing from the Esplanade, away from the cables. Then we cross the lines properly.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: There. Three clean bearings, one crossing. Downtown, by the parking structure.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's a SureThing van. And that's a relay dish going into the back of it.

lines.speaker: TECH
lines.text: Oh, come on. I'm on my lunch.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: He's leaving! If the relay goes with him, so does our evidence.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Stop the van. Don't hurt him. We need him talking.

lines.speaker: TECH
lines.text: Okay! Okay! I'm out! I just install the things, man!

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Install what?

lines.speaker: TECH
lines.text: Relays. Upload boxes. They told me CERTAIN was switched off. They said these were for weather.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Weather with a CERTAIN header on every packet.

lines.speaker: TECH
lines.text: Look, I don't get paid enough to have an opinion.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Grab the relay out of the back, Carl.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: So. We could publish the recording right now. Everybody's listening. The timing's perfect.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Or we take the relay to the lab and check it properly. But it's wiping its own memory. We'd have four minutes.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: And if we put it out now?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Then SureThing says we faked a beep, and they'll pick at every gap. Your call, Carl.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Shielded box in the lab. Four minutes. Drive the way you always drive, but on purpose.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Two minutes. The memory counter's falling.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We're here. Box, now!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Wiped. We've still got the recording. It just won't carry the same weight.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Uploading the recording to the registry. Done. Now it's everybody's ghost.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Let's take the relay back anyway. No rush.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Control run. Relay unplugged... silence. Plugged in... seven short, one long. It's the relay.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: And every packet says STC-CERT. CERTAIN was supposed to be switched off two weeks ago.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So the ghost was a robot that didn't know it got fired.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That is honestly the best summary I've heard.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: SureThing Technologies confirms a 'legacy relay' was left running in Downtown San Fierro. The company says it was a clerical error.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: SureThing calls a recording released by an independent lab 'unverifiable'. The lab has published its methods and invited anyone to check them.

lines.speaker: REX
lines.text: So it was a robot. Fine. But who's to say a robot can't be a ghost? Lines are open.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, this city.

claims.headline: The ghost signal comes from this neon sign.
The ghost transmitter is on the Gant Bridge.
evidence: No hardware seen on the span
